Small-loss ball B_{alpha,T} is correctly recorded as adversarial_restricted, with the restriction stored in parameters.
Small-variation ball V_{alpha,T} is correctly recorded as adversarial_restricted.
Effective-range restriction C_rho is recorded correctly.
Restriction to sequences with an arm optimal in every round is recorded correctly.
Theorem 1: expression 1/27 sqrt((K-1)T log(1/(4delta))) holds with probability >= delta/2. Conditions match the statement.
Theorem 2: expression sqrt((K-1)T) log(1/(4delta))/(203C), with C correctly declared as C_exp. The algorithm class (strategies with expected regret <= C sqrt((K-1)T)) is correctly marked 'other'.
Theorem 3: sqrt(alpha T K)/27. Conditions on T and alpha are correct.
Theorem 4: sqrt(alpha T K)/25. Conditions are correct.
Corollary 5: sqrt(T(K-1))/504, for loss sequences with an always-optimal arm. Correct.

missing_results.label: cor:high-prob
missing_results.description: Impossibility: for p in (0,1), no strategy has a high-probability regret bound of C sqrt((K-1)T) log^p(1/delta) for all T, K, loss sequences and delta.
missing_results.quote: If $p \in (0,1)$ and $C > 0$, then there does not exist a strategy such that for all $T$, $K$, $\ell_{1:T} \in [0,1]^{KT}$ and $\delta \in (0,1)$ the regret is bounded by $\Pr{R_T(\ell_{1:T}) \geq C \sqrt{(K-1)T} \log^p(1/\delta)} \leq \delta$.

summary: The extraction is accurate. All six lower bounds (Theorems 1–4, Corollaries 4–5) have the correct constants, conditions and settings. Corollaries 1–2 restate cited upper bounds and are correctly left out of the results. The only gap is that Corollary 3, an impossibility result for high-probability bounds, is mentioned only in the notes of r2 and has no result of its own.
